name: sub-agent-compact
description: Smart auto-compact for Claude Code: a separate compaction point for every sub-agent, and self-compaction at a milestone the model chooses.

mainAutoCompact.title: Main chat: forced compaction point
mainAutoCompact.description: Where the main chat is compacted even if its model never asked: a percentage of the model's window ("30%"), or tokens: an integer or a k/m suffix ("300k").

mainAutoCompactNudgeStart.title: Main chat: first nudge
mainAutoCompactNudgeStart.description: Where the main chat is first told to reach a milestone and compact itself: a percentage of the model's window ("30%"), or tokens: an integer or a k/m suffix ("300k").

mainAutoCompactNudgeEvery.title: Main chat: nudge step
mainAutoCompactNudgeEvery.description: The step between nudges past the first, for the main chat: a percentage of the model's window ("30%"), or tokens: an integer or a k/m suffix ("300k").

mainAutoCompactEnabled.title: Main chat: automatic compaction
mainAutoCompactEnabled.description: Off: the main chat is never nudged or compacted automatically; its own request to compact still runs.

subagentAutoCompact.title: Sub-agent: forced compaction point
subagentAutoCompact.description: Where a sub-agent whose definition does not set it (frontmatter overrides it) is compacted even if its model never asked: a percentage of the model's window ("30%"), or tokens: an integer or a k/m suffix ("300k").

subagentAutoCompactNudgeStart.title: Sub-agent: first nudge
subagentAutoCompactNudgeStart.description: Where a sub-agent whose definition does not set it (frontmatter overrides it) is first told to reach a milestone and compact itself: a percentage of the model's window ("30%"), or tokens: an integer or a k/m suffix ("300k").

subagentAutoCompactNudgeEvery.title: Sub-agent: nudge step
subagentAutoCompactNudgeEvery.description: The step between nudges past the first, for a sub-agent whose definition does not set it (frontmatter overrides it): a percentage of the model's window ("30%"), or tokens: an integer or a k/m suffix ("300k").

subagentAutoCompactEnabled.title: Sub-agent: automatic compaction
subagentAutoCompactEnabled.description: Off: a sub-agent whose definition does not set it (frontmatter overrides it) is never nudged or compacted automatically; its own request to compact still runs.

subagentKeepBrief.title: Sub-agent: keep its brief
subagentKeepBrief.description: On: after each compaction a sub-agent's brief, the prompt its parent passed, is seated again verbatim right after the summary, up to 64k tokens. Off: the summary alone stands for it.

handoffTool.title: Handoff tool
handoffTool.description: On: models get the handoff tool. The text a model passes replaces its whole conversation so far, installed verbatim with no summarizer request; what it does after the call is kept. A sub-agent without the tool writes <handoff>its handoff</handoff>.

forwardHandoffTool.title: Forward handoff tool
forwardHandoffTool.description: On: every party (the main chat and each sub-agent) gets the forward_handoff tool. Code carries the last 25 prompts, skills, file trail, plan, running work and git state into the wake text; the model writes only its objective, done, remaining and next. Installed verbatim when its turn ends; the call's files are saved under the Claude config directory.

compactTool.title: Compact tool
compactTool.description: On: models also get the compact tool, whose focus a summarizer turns into a summary, and <compact-now> markers count. Off: the handoff replaces it.

agentDirs.title: Extra agent-definition directories
agentDirs.description: Comma-separated directories searched for agent definitions after <cwd>/.claude/agents and ~/.claude/agents.

logFile.title: Decision log file
logFile.description: Absolute path of a JSONL file that records every compaction decision; empty for none.
